//sprite: DEFAULT grid config for all animations. Change it here if the sheet size changes. Each animation below may override the same fields when different.
//defaultFacing: Direction the walk sprite faces as-is (before flipping). Set to 'left' if the sheet is replaced with a left-facing one.
//idleFootGap: Gap (rendered px) between idle's own drawn feet and the position anchor. Other animations are calibrated via scale/offsetY to match this same gap so switching between them doesn't jump. Movement targets that need literal contact with an element edge (e.g. 'sit') add this value back in to compensate.
//actionAnimations: Maps action -> animation name. Actions without their own sheet point to 'idle' as a fallback.
